notes: Mixed null is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed bool false is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed bool true is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed int zero negates to zero.
Mixed int non-zero negates to the matching negative value.
Mixed float zero negates to signed zero.
Mixed float non-zero negates to the matching negative value.
Mixed empty string is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed string 0 is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed string bool literal is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed string bool literal is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed non-numeric string is not a valid operand for unary minus.
Mixed hash is not a valid operand for unary minus.
